description: Canonical evidence-backed health matrix for the nine kernel organs. Machine-generated only; stamped with the exact evaluated SHA. Normative rules live in BRAIN/03-KERNEL/0005-NINE-ORGAN-HEALTH-MATRIX-SPEC-V1.md.

ci_state_at_stamp.description: Required CI check conclusions on stamped_sha that bound the matrix (kernel-tests, chain-readiness-gate, current-truth-resolver).

evaluator.description: Who/what ran the generator (e.g. naya-2-build-loop, human name).

blockers.description: Human gates, missing artifacts, or decisions blocking the next rung.

current_rung.description: Highest rung proven by primary evidence on stamped_sha. UNKNOWN when no rung is proven.

missing_rung.description: The very next rung not proven, or null when the organ reached SUCCESSOR.

next_proof.description: Concrete, checkable description of the single proof that would close missing_rung (workflow/check name or human receipt). Null only at SUCCESSOR.

refs.description: Primary evidence refs: check_run ids, workflow run ids, repo paths pinned to stamped_sha, or receipt ids. No memory/chat/PR-description refs.

stamped_sha.description: Exact main-tip SHA this matrix was evaluated against. Evidence on any other SHA proves nothing about this SHA.

title: NayaPOWER Nine-Organ Health Matrix V1
